headline: Kieran Morrison
body: Gomez injury overshadows winning start for Iraola. Liverpool start life under Andoni Iraola with a 4-2 win over Sunderland thanks to goals from Kieran Morrison, Dominik Szoboszlai, Federico Chiesa and Lewis Koumas.
